items.question: Who is Qentrah built for?
items.answer: Qentrah is built for real estate developers, brokerage teams, and operators who need one trusted workspace for projects, units, clients, approvals, and handoffs.

items.question: How does onboarding work?
items.answer: Teams can start with the workspace, then map their project, inventory, client, and organization flows with the Qentrah team when deeper setup is needed.

items.question: Can developers and brokers work from the same data?
items.answer: Yes. Qentrah is designed around shared project and inventory context so developers, brokers, and operations teams can act from the same verified records.

items.question: How is pricing handled?
items.answer: Pricing starts with the published plans on this page. Larger teams can contact Qentrah for an implementation conversation around organization structure, workflows, and support.

items.question: What makes the workspace trustworthy?
items.answer: The product keeps roles, statuses, approvals, media, and operational records close to the work, so teams can see what is ready, blocked, pending, or synced before moving forward.
